summary: NKGen Biotech filed an 8-K regarding a Second Amendment to its Secured Convertible Loan Agreement with AlpineBrook Capital GP I Limited. The amendment provides an additional $412,500 loan (net $375,000 after a $37,500 facilitation fee), documented by a new convertible promissory note with a conversion price of $0.08 per share. Consideration shares increased to 12,147,280, deliverable in installments over 25 months. This is a routine financing amendment, not a special situation such as a restructuring or capital return.
